subject: Kevin David Mitnick (1963–2023) & The Philosophy of Social Engineering
thesis: The strongest cryptographic firewall in the world is rendered obsolete if an attacker can convince an authorized human to bypass it.

core_mechanisms.description: Creating an invented scenario that forces the target to volunteer privileged information.
Assuming the identity of senior executives, IT administrators, or field technicians.
Fabricating an imminent system deadline or emergency to suppress critical scrutiny.
Using small, harmless pieces of corporate jargon gathered from one employee to deceive the next.

historical_milestones.event: Early phone phreaking and Los Angeles bus punch card system manipulation.
DEC (Digital Equipment Corporation) VMS source code acquisition.
Underground fugitive period and compromise of Motorola and Pacific Bell systems.
FBI arrest in Raleigh, North Carolina.
Transition to trusted defensive security consultant, author, and global educator.
